decision_conditions:
<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The development hereby permitted shall be
used for Class C3 dwellinghouse(s) only and notwithstanding the provisions of
the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order
2015 (or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order with or without
modification), no development within Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L shall take
place.</span></p>
<p>The refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, in the designated refuse storage area, as originally approved under P/3792/20.</p>

<p>The development shall not be occupied until cycle storage is installed in accordance with the details approved under details application PL/0406/23 and maintained as such thereafter.</p><div><br></div>

<p>The Development will be implemented in accordance with hereby approved Fire Statement In Line With London D12A dated 17th May 2024 by Nadim Choudhary. The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p><div><br></div>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;</p><p>Fire Statement In Line With London D12A by Nadim Choudhary CEng MEng FIMechE MIFireE MCIBSE (dated 17th May 2024)</p><p>All other plans as approved under application reference P/3792/20</p><div><br></div>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description:
Variation of Condition 6 (Fire Safety Strategy) attached to planning permission P/3792/20 dated 26/04/2021 to read ' The Development will be implemented in accordance with attached Fire Statement In Line With London D12A dated
17th May 2024.
The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.
